data.description:
## Context
While broadening verification for runty-effectible-bluewhale on current origin/main, `tests/interfaces/store/test_bridge_preview_under_sync_contention_heldout.py::test_preview_is_complete_while_sync_locks_are_held` failed deterministically, both in the 443-test store suite and alone. `_advisory_lock._lock_remote` imports `from rebar_reconciler import git_adapter`, but that top-level package is not importable in the normal repo virtualenv, raising `ModuleNotFoundError` before the lock behavior executes. This is unrelated to attach-commits code-root changes.

## Plan
- Reproduce under the supported test/install environment.
- Trace the intended packaged/lazy reconciler import seam.
- Restore the test and production lock path without test-only sys.path pollution.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The exact held-out contention test passes in isolation.
- [ ] The broader store suite passes.
- [ ] The reconciler import uses a supported packaged path.
data.title: Bridge preview lock test cannot import reconciler package
